text: Artificial intelligence is changing our world, but it also raises important ethical questions. One major concern is bias: if the data used to train AI contains unfair patterns, the AI can make discriminatory decisions, such as rejecting job applications based on race or gender. To ensure fairness, developers must carefully check their systems for hidden prejudices. Another critical issue is privacy, since AI often collects large amounts of personal data. Transparency is equally vital—people deserve to know how and why an AI makes a decision. Ultimately, responsible AI development requires a balanced approach, where technology benefits society while protecting individual rights and promoting trust.
